description: Returns one business as its page shows it, blending the Little Milwaukee listing (when listed), the City of Milwaukee license records and the entity data (OpenStreetMap, Wikidata, the business's website): the status with what it rests on, the At a glance facts with each fact's source and check date, the listing's why (or a paragraph from the record), photos, mentions, actions and sources. Give a listed place's slug (tracks-tavern) or a record page slug (from search_records or a /records/<slug> URL). The same object is the JSON form of the page. License holder names and names under review are never shown. An unknown slug returns { "error": "not_found" }.

slug.description: A listed place's slug, for example tracks-tavern, or a record page slug, for example example-tavern-1a2b3c.

name: get_entity
